name: Muhammad Anwer

paragraphs.text: Full-stack engineer focused on building high-impact products: from rapid 0→1 MVPs to scalable, production systems. I combine product thinking, strong systems design, and execution speed to deliver meaningful results.

I strongly believe in iterative approaches: identify a problem, prototype a solution, test it with real users, build/pivot accordingly. AI is part of that loop end-to-end, from scoping to development and beyond.

wins.title: Idea to paid pilot
wins.description: Took ESGTree's financed-emissions platform from idea to production with a team of 2, won a competitive vendor demo with Desjardins, then led the full-scale rollout.

wins.title: Conversion lift from guest checkout
wins.description: Shipped subscription guest checkout end-to-end in 1 week at LaunchGood, fixing security risks in the original proposal. Over 50% of new subscribers chose it.

wins.title: Get Better Together
wins.description: Designed and shipped a social fitness app end-to-end with AI agents: leaderboards, user auth, and a guest mode that lets people join a challenge in seconds.

value.text: Turn ambiguous problems into shipped product and iterate from usage data (PostHog, Heap, BigQuery). Scoping, build, and launch stay with me, weighed against cost and customer impact.
Daily work is agent-first. A shared

AGENTS.md gives Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode the same business rules and routes each task to its guides, decision logs, and ticket context. Skills I write for myself and the team take recurring work, such as PR-feedback triage, off the critical path.

TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vite, Redux, and Tailwind CSS on the front end; NestJS, Prisma, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL on the back end; Python and SQL for data. Tests in Playwright, Vitest, and Jest.

Design multi-tenant SaaS and event-driven services (RabbitMQ) in Nx monorepos, with contract-first REST/OpenAPI, type-safe clients, and PostgreSQL models and migrations to match. RFCs and design reviews are how I lead that design.

Each PR passes GitHub Actions tests and a throwaway preview before merge, and new client-facing features ship behind feature flags. Review is layered the same way: Greptile and Claude, backend and frontend reviewer agents I built, an AI security review on every push, plus secret scanning, SAST, dependency audit, and DAST.
On-call runs from triage and mitigation through RCA, runbooks, and post-incident hardening. Datadog, Sentry, and PostHog cover AWS, Docker, and Railway.

event streams between billing and other platform services, with a focus on secure, reliable handling of customer and usage data.

Work with product, finance, and engineering teams to turn billing requirements into technical solutions, and break large initiatives into deliverable work in a fast-paced environment with multiple releases a day.
Use agentic AI development workflows, including custom skills, sub-agents, context files, and MCP integrations, to speed up delivery and code quality across the team.

efficient, thorough scoping built for an agentic team: locked decision logs, a smallest-possible core before iterations, and tickets written so any engineer or coding agent can pick them up cold.

preview per PR for hands-on verification. Turned each production incident into a written rule enforced in review, so the same mistake is caught once.

Built full-stack features for a global fundraising marketplace that powers one-time and recurring donations across 150+ countries. Worked across
monorepo of 23 services and 17 shared libraries.

Shipped a leadership priority in one week: guest subscription creation and one-click account completion. Pushed back on security risks in the first proposal and shipped a safer design. Over 50% of new subscribers used guest checkout after launch, and conversion improved by ~40%.

Led enrollment for scheduled-giving programs and replaced the legacy flow with one shared path: amount, review, and giving-grid screens, a mobile currency drawer, and program-specific impact widgets. Moved shared enrollment cards out of React context so new programs reuse one route, and kept multi-step state in Redux behind a server-rendered shell for faster initial loads.

Turned an ambiguous ask for pageviews and time on route into the plan the build followed: which pageviews count, how a session becomes a user, the BigQuery facts, and who may read them. Shipped it as an hourly PostHog export, campaign pageview facts and per-route duration, an identity map that keeps pre-login views on the user, and a read API for the caller, the campaign owner, and an audited admin route behind a feature flag.

Server-rendered campaign stories in the first HTML response so search and answer engines could index them. Those routes had been returning about 160 bytes until JavaScript ran, and the same render corrected hydration that showed goals as 0 USD and raised amounts about 100 below the true figure.

Built social-style public profiles for partners and influencers and the admin dashboards for engagement and audience insights, from schema design and REST APIs through the Next.js UI and tests for critical paths.

Took a set of Figma files through a plan, a build, and a publish. An RFC set the decisions, a component-by-component plan turned them into tickets, and the build shipped @launchgood/heart-and-soul as a private GitHub Package: source TypeScript and Tailwind, 26 components, Storybook, Vitest, and Playwright. Designers review each component in Storybook and send fixes back to the agent until they mark it ready to ship.

Turned manual runbooks into Retool apps and manual processes into agentic skills. Donor lookup and scheduled-giving dashboards cut billing triage from hours to minutes, and a triage skill ties each website-support request to its ticket and leaves an investigation view for the next on-call.
Bootstrapped and scaled two online ventures over a decade: an e-learning platform and an Amazon FBA storefront, ultimately exiting with ongoing royalty income.

: defined the catalog, designed packaging and listing imagery, and shaped the customer-facing brand end-to-end - acting as solo product manager, designer, and copywriter to ship a coherent line of digital and physical goods.
: qualified overseas manufacturers, negotiated unit economics and MOQs, and coordinated quality control and logistics to keep margins healthy as volume scaled.
: ran SEO, paid acquisition, email funnels, and Amazon listing optimization to grow a global customer base; iterated on copy and creative based on conversion data to lift repeat purchase rates.
: authored and produced the full course library for the e-learning venture (video, written lessons, assessments), then maintained it through multiple revisions as the curriculum matured.
: owned inventory planning, cash flow, taxes, returns, and customer support across both ventures; turned operating discipline into a profitable steady-state that supported a successful exit.

: grew both ventures to sustainable profitability, sold the e-learning platform to a strategic acquirer with continuing royalty income, and built the systems thinking and product instincts I bring to engineering work today.
